 Implementation; Urban Development;

Total number of questions — 20
Public consultation on Right to
Information Act
*21. SHRI PRAMOD MAHAJAN:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Department of Personnel
and Training despite assurances did not
initiate public consultations on the rules
and guidelines before implementation of the
Right to Information Act; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor?
National Highways in Kerala
*22. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
SHIPPING, ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of projects seeking
financial assistance to improve the National
Highways in Kerala pending with
Government for sanction;
(b) the amount of funds allotted to
Kerala for the improvement of National
Highways during the current year and the
details of the projects; and
(c) the present stage of Kollam bypass
in Kerala and the proposed plan for the
implementation of subsequent phases?
Agreement with Malaysia
*23. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether India and Malaysia have
agreed to strengthen the cooperation in the
information and communication technology
sector; and
(b) if so, the details thereof ?
Utilization of employment exchanges
*24. MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
KHAN AZMI:
SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN:
Will the Minister of  LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that now-a-days,
employment exchanges in the country are

8
playing little role in getting employment to
the educated unemployed; and
(b) if so, in what manner Government
propose to utilize these employment
exchanges in a more fruitful manner?
Projects under MPLADS
*25. SHRI SANTARAM LAXMAN
NAIK: Will the Minister of  STATISTICS
AND PROGRAMME
IMPLEMENTATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
enact a legislation to regulate recommen-
dation, sanction and execution of projects
under MPLADS;
(b) whether existing guidelines are
proposed to be amended; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Municipal Solid Waste Energy
Projects
*26. SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
have taken any steps to set up 'Municipal
Solid Waste Energy Projects' in urban areas
of our country in order to reduce
environmental pollution and to generate
additional energy;
(b) if so, the total financial allocations
for this project, State-wise;
(c) whether Government's target has
been achieved, so far; and
(d) if so, the details thereof along with
the total power being generated through
this scheme annually?
Progress of road projects
*27. SHRI RAASHID ALVI:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of  SHIPPIN G,
ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it has been reported that
inspite of Prime Minister's thrust on
infrastructure, road projects in the country
are not progressing well;
(b) if so, whether progress report on all
major highways upgrade plans are marked
red, with work either at a complete standstill
or moving at snail's pace, way behind
schedule;
(c) whether the biggest problem seems
to be land acquisition, followed by
contractual failures;
(d) if so, what are the other main
reasons; and
(e) what steps Government propose to
take to remove these hurdles and to what
extent present Government have been able
to expedite the completion of these projects
at the scheduled time?
Production/sale of Khadi products

SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether production/sale of Khadi
products in the country has declined;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) the steps taken or being taken by
Government to raise the production/sale
of Khadi in the country;
(d) the quantum of production and sale

MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased

Development of sports in A.P.
130. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the allocation of funds
for the development of sports stadium and
its infrastructure in Andhra Pradesh;
(b) whether Government have provided/
allocated the funds in this regard, State-
wise; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
PMRY in Andhra Pradesh
131. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the funds released
during the last two years under the Pradhan
Mantri Rozgar Yojana, State-wise;
(b) whether any assessment has been
made about the utilization of these funds;
(c) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and
(d) the details of unemployed youths
of Andhra Pradesh receiving funds under
the PMRY, district-wise?
Sale of Khadi products
132. SHRI  T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the production and sale of
Khadi products had registered a decreasing
trend after 1998-99;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) whether Government  would make
it mandatory for Government/Public Sector
Organization to buy khadi products
according to  need, to develop Khadi
industries?

30
 Traditional and cottage industries
†133. SHRI  KRIPAL PARMAR:
SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
 Will the  Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether inspite of several steps
taken by Government for improving the
traditional and cottage industries during the
last few years, the migration of rural youths
in search of jobs towards the cities has
increased manifold;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have
conducted any survey to ascertain the
reasons for migration of youths to the cities
from village;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the steps taken or proposed to be
taken to check this tendency ?
 Package for tiny sector
134. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of SMALL SCALE
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any policy initiative
or separate package of incentives for tiny
sector to improve their competitive
Resilience;
(b) whether there is inter sectoral co-
ordination and cooperation mechanism
among the concerned ministers and other
ministries;
(c)  whether  a 'Swot' analysis was done
on the working of small scale and tiny
sector; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Commercial operations at
Kundankulam
135. SHRIMATI C. PERUMAL: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it has been decided to
expand nuclear power station at
Kundankulam and other stations;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any target has been fixed
for commencement of commercial
operations; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Coal shortage
136. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRIMATI JAMANA DEVI
BARUPAL:
 Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether after alarm call of a 95-
million tonne of coal shortage by  2012
Government have drawn up an emergency
coal production plan;
(b) whether under this plan India's
production target of 525 million tonne by
2011-2012 would be achieved;
(c) whether there is a dispute over this
fact that additional production had not come
into extent that it was expected due to non-
approval of projects in Ninth Five Year
Plan period;
(d) if so, what were targets set in Tenth
Five Year Plan and to what extent it has
been achieved;
(e) whether long term measure of coal
are being considered in Eleventh Five Year
Plan period; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

31
 Alignment of domestic coal prices
137. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Deputy Chairman of
the Planning Commission, while
inaugurating a two-day seminar on coal in
Delhi on the 19th October, 2005, stated
that it was time to align domestic coal prices
with international prices;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) Government's reaction thereto?
